product_policy.local_anchor: apply a provenance-bound local directional reference only during its declared validity period; currently sensor 107 in 2025
product_policy.single_direction_station_opposite: unmeasured; no transferred hard bound or soft dirsplit prior in release demand
product_policy.route_slots: three central-demand replicas retained for the established three-seed monthly runner contract
product_policy.diagnostic_stress: q10/q90 are substituted only by --direction-stress-variants and do not become release evidence
product_policy.conditional_phases: closed; do not add direction ensemble, monthly schema, warm-state, API or UI machinery

interpretation: BASELINE does not claim that every real road is exactly 50/50, and NO does not claim zero direction uncertainty. Together they show that the transferred point model was not robustly better than the baseline and that the registered plausible direction range did not change the deployed closure decision. The smallest defensible release policy is therefore central 50/50 plus authoritative local evidence.
safety: Low observability weakens confidence and claims; it does not ban a road. Topology, survivability and no-detour remain independent hard safety gates.
